author_reading.rationale: Four data bits are independently exposed to destination capture without a synchronizing protocol or coherence mechanism.

rationale: The four-bit clk_a word is sampled directly by asynchronous clk_b. Bits may change together and be captured incoherently; no qualification, Gray encoding, or stability protocol exists. Boundary domains are explicit, so the defect is decidable.

labels.rationale: The four-bit clk_a word is sampled directly by asynchronous clk_b. Bits may change together and be captured incoherently; no qualification, Gray encoding, or stability protocol exists. Boundary domains are explicit, so the defect is decidable.

An arbitrary four-bit value updates every clk_a edge and is captured directly on asynchronous clk_b, without synchronization, encoding, stability or a qualifying protocol. Different bits can represent different source words.
